confidence_notes: Food estimates draw on an April snapshot from [Numbeo](https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/Mendoza-Argentina) and later prices from [Wise](https://wise.com/us/cost-of-living/argentina/mendoza), so July values are approximate. Cocktail and wine prices are inferred from their likely relationship to beer. Accommodation prices are holistic estimates; inflation, exchange rates and seasonal demand add uncertainty.
comparable_city_reasoning: Accommodation estimates use other mid-sized Argentine tourist cities, adjusted for Mendoza's wine tourism and July winter travel demand.
